       s.circle,
       s.tenure_months,
       s.unresolved_complaints,
       s.days_since_last_recharge,
       sc.churn_score,
       sc.clv_predicted,
       sc.segment,
       oa.offer_code,
       oa.offer_name,
       oa.discount_pct,
       oa.bonus_data_gb,
       oa.expected_uplift_pct
FROM subscribers s
JOIN scored_subscribers sc ON s.subscriber_id = sc.subscriber_id
OUTER APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 offer_code,
                offer_name,
                discount_pct,
                bonus_data_gb,
                expected_uplift_pct
    FROM offer_catalogue oc
    WHERE oc.approval_status = 'Active'
      AND (oc.approved_circles LIKE '%' + s.circle + '%'
           OR oc.approved_circles LIKE '%' + s.circle_code + '%')
    ORDER BY oc.expected_uplift_pct DESC
) oa
WHERE s.subscriber_id = 'JIO10037241';
